user_problem: A fixed set of practice items needs distributing across sessions while respecting supplied prerequisites and review intervals.
unique_output: A session schedule showing new practice, retrieval review, cumulative mixing, and deferred items with reasons.
required_input: Item list, skill tags, prerequisite order, session count, capacity, and allowed review intervals.
critical_rule: Do not claim an optimal learning effect; produce a constraint-satisfying schedule and expose conflicts.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is recurring-task-boundary-checker; this schedules bounded learning practice rather than defining authorization for recurring work.
acceptance_scenario: Input skills A before B, items A1,A2,B1, three sessions of two slots, review after one session. Output places A practice before B1, schedules an A retrieval in the next session, and shows unused capacity explicitly.
